gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sahitya: That horseshoe-shaped c gives Cherry Swash a swagger no one could miss, with every bar and diagonal as heavy as its stems. And Sahitya, a text serif with a gentle thick-thin shift and open s and c shapes, takes over once the shouting is done.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Chunky, wire-bent swagger from Cherry Swash, with no thick-thin shift to slow the eye, then Sawarabi Mincho, a text serif whose curves ease gently in weight. They trade bluntness for polish.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sedan: Sedan, a text serif with mellow stroke weights and terminals held back from the stems, has a bookish authority. And Cherry Swash above it draws every stroke at a single stylus width, so its horseshoe c feels bold and blunt against that softness.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sedan-sc: Cherry Swash runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with a wide horseshoe c that stands out at once. But Sedan SC, a serif with broad open counters and a slight pinch where curves meet stems, does its best work in quieter, literary lines.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-shippori-mincho: Shippori Mincho reads classic and literary, with modest contrast and generous curves. Cherry Swash above it has bowls that never thin at the sides, so a longer passage moves from blunt wire-like headings into text that feels lightly engraved.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-shippori-mincho-b: Cherry Swash looks bent from a single wire, its c opened wide like a horseshoe, with diagonals as heavy as the verticals. Shippori Mincho B1 is the refined serif beside it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-spectral-sc: Cherry Swash cuts its letters like laser-cut sheet at one stroke width, with a wide horseshoe c. Yet its strongest quality is the contrast with Spectral SC, a text serif whose mild taper feels like wire rolled barely flat.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-stix-two-text: Cherry Swash keeps its curves from thinning at the shoulders, so the horseshoe c and heavy diagonals feel blunt and commanding against STIX Two Text, a serif that tapers like a candle flame. The strongest quality is that tension.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Blunt, wire-bent and bold, with a horseshoe c and no hairlines anywhere. Cherry Swash is best at making a loud statement, while Tai Heritage Pro, a classic serif with open channels into its round letters, handles the dignified editorial text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-taviraj: Cherry Swash draws plain, stitched-thread strokes with a wide horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, which makes a commanding heading. Taviraj, a text serif, tapers gently from stem to joint.
